name: Family Ceramics Workshop
description: Get your hands dirty and create something beautiful together at a "Cerâmica em Família" session, open to all ages and skill levels.
longDescription:
The "Cerâmica em Família" workshop offers an opportunity for participants of all generations to engage with clay and learn basic pottery techniques. This hands-on session is designed to foster shared creativity and introduce the fundamentals of ceramic art in a supportive environment. The workshop aims to provide an accessible entry point into crafting with clay, encouraging collaborative art-making.

Attendees can expect a relaxed and engaging atmosphere, where guidance is provided for working with the material. The session is structured to allow individuals and families to explore their artistic ideas and produce their own ceramic pieces. The workshop is open to all ages and skill levels, making it suitable for beginners and those with some prior experience. The venue at Rua Duque de Saldanha 416 provides an indoor setting for the activity.

Booking is required to secure participation in this workshop. The venue is located on Rua Duque de Saldanha, accessible via public transport. It is approximately a 15-minute walk from the São Bento train station, or a short bus ride from various points in the city centre. The workshop is specifically designed to be family-friendly.
